metadata.title: Morse resolution of mean curvature flows with cylindrical singularities
metadata.abstract: We show that a compact mean curvature flow whose singularities have multiplicity-one cylindrical tangent flows admits a smooth Morse resolution. The resolution agrees with the spacetime track outside any prescribed neighborhood of its singular set and all its critical points have the expected index. No nondegeneracy or isolatedness assumption is required. In the mean-convex case the result follows by smoothing the global arrival function.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明具有重数一圆柱切流奇点的紧平均曲率流可作光滑 Morse 解析化，在任意给定奇点邻域之外保持原时空轨迹，临界点具有预期指标。
techniques: 到达时间卷积平滑与 Morse 扰动
analysis.breakthrough: 不要求奇点非退化或孤立，扩大流的拓扑解析化适用范围。
analysis.limitations: 仍要求全部奇点切流为重数一圆柱，不包含任意流奇点；平均凸情形只是其中较直接的特例。 已补读PDF第1–3页及定理2.1、推论2.2；精确设置为单位正则积分 Brakke 流、紧支撑和正则端点，Morse 指标有指定下界。一般情形使用近期平均凸邻域结果。 未逐行审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者声明数学解法源于作者间讨论，AI 仅辅助论文写作、不参与数学思想发展；作者反复修改并独立核验。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.18687v1 · PDF第3页，Statement on the use of AI
